stemBlocks: The family tree shows a family affected by a dominant genetic condition. All people who carry the mutation show symptoms of the condition.
Which of the following statements could explain the presence of the dominant condition in female R?

1 The mutation occurs in P.
2 The mutation occurs in Q's father.
3 The mutation occurs in R.

assets.alt: Key: male without condition (empty square), male with condition (filled square), female without condition (empty circle), female with condition (filled circle). Pedigree chart shows individuals P, Q, and R.
